request.Accept: Media types the client can handle, e.g. application/json
request.Accept-Encoding: Compression formats the client supports, e.g. gzip, br
request.Accept-Language: Preferred response languages, e.g. en-US, si-LK
request.Authorization: Credentials for the request, e.g. Bearer <token>
request.Content-Type: Media type of the request body, e.g. application/json
request.Content-Length: Size of the request body in bytes
request.Cookie: Cookies previously set by the server
request.Host: Target host and port of the request
request.If-None-Match: Conditional request using an ETag value
request.If-Modified-Since: Conditional request using a last-modified date
request.Origin: Origin of the request (used in CORS)
request.Referer: URL of the page that made the request
request.X-Requested-With: Commonly XMLHttpRequest to flag AJAX calls

response.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: Origins allowed to read the response (CORS)
response.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: HTTP methods allowed for cross-origin requests
response.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Request headers allowed for cross-origin requests
response.Content-Type: Media type of the response body
response.Content-Encoding: Compression applied to the body, e.g. gzip
response.Content-Disposition: Inline display or attachment download with filename
response.ETag: Version identifier of the resource for caching
response.Expires: Date after which the response is considered stale
response.Last-Modified: Date the resource was last changed
response.Location: Redirect target or URL of a newly created resource
response.Retry-After: Seconds or date to wait before retrying (used with 429/503)
response.Set-Cookie: Sets a cookie on the client
response.Vary: Request headers that affect the cached response

security.Content-Security-Policy: Restricts sources of scripts, styles, images, etc.
security.Strict-Transport-Security: Forces HTTPS for future requests, e.g. max-age=31536000
security.Referrer-Policy: Controls how much referrer info is sent
security.Permissions-Policy: Enables or disables browser features like camera, geolocation
